figurative_meaning_bn: বিয়ে বা শ্রাদ্ধে দানের জন্য সাজিয়ে রাখা সামগ্রী
figurative_meaning_en: Items prepared and arranged for donation during weddings or funeral rites (shraddha)
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিয়ের আয়োজনে দানসামগ্রী সাজিয়ে রাখা হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Donation items have been prepared for the wedding ceremony.
Prepare the donation materials for the shraddha ritual.
note: This term is more of a cultural compound word than a strictly figurative idiom, commonly used in traditional Bengali rituals.
